guide.intent: The project’s plans, with New plan and Load sample plan. Each row opens that plan’s Gantt. A replica of Beacon’s pages/plan-list.
decisions: REPLICA, NOT A SPEC. Read Beacon’s origin/develop for behavior; this page mirrors it, including its complexity.
Load sample plan is prod’s temporary demo scaffolding (BCN-1788), kept because prod still has it.
gotchas: Plans persist in this browser only. Clearing site data empties the list.
acceptance: With no plans, the empty state offers New plan and Load sample plan.
Load sample plan creates a plan and opens its Gantt.
